author_lineage: The fixture author also authored the pinned owner successor002 and prior producer/control sources. This is author preparation, not independent source or scientific acceptance.
future_explicit_read_scope: Only the pinned first-party owner source is read by extracted_namespace, once per scenario. The other seven records are preparation provenance for review; the fixture does not dereference their maps. Normal Python fixture/stdlib loading is a separate future runtime admission boundary.

extraction.selection: Unmodified top-level FunctionDef AST nodes selected by exact names after whole-source SHA256/byte-count verification.

static_dependency_check.method: AST loads minus parameters/local stores/except names, unioned over the seven selected definitions; compare against selected definitions, explicit namespace keys and the restricted builtin allowlist. This is name-coverage evidence only, not execution.

fake_provider_boundaries.process: Fake Popen returns one SimpleNamespace; fake waitpid returns a stopped status then raw0. No Popen import or real child.
fake_provider_boundaries.group_and_signal: Fake PID/PGID/SID, kqueue registration/NOTE_EXIT, signals/default SIGCHLD and group-absence callback. Unexpected fake killpg/_exit are forbidden assertions; there is no real-provider fallback.
fake_provider_boundaries.clock: Deterministic in-memory monotonic counter and sleep callback.
fake_provider_boundaries.filesystem: FakePath/FakeHandle/FakeFS keep all target streams/reports/receipt bytes in a memory dictionary. No __fspath__, real open, real target path, actual/admission or output root is provided.
fake_provider_boundaries.errors: Synthetic error strings via fake traceback.format_exc; no real traceback/linecache provider is exposed to the selected definitions.
fake_provider_boundaries.admission: Stubbed admit returns synthetic records/identity/aliases/argv. It does not establish operational admission.
fake_provider_boundaries.helper_report_acceptance: Stubbed normal_reports supplies accepted pre-F1 report descriptors/capture placeholder. It does not read or validate adapter/helper content or sixteen output files.
fake_provider_boundaries.identity_resources: Identity/aliases/limits/inclusive-byte/RSS callbacks are synthetic; no real freshness, resource, ABI, peak-RSS, lifecycle or group-absence claim follows.
fake_provider_boundaries.pure_serialization: json only serializes/deserializes in-memory values; hashlib only verifies the explicitly pinned first-party source bytes.

coverage: Each scenario reaches the actual owner main, final finally block, serialized closed-result receipt and actual return-code expression. Shared assertions require positive earlier normal prerequisites so a negative case cannot pass through unrelated setup/cleanup failure. Error cases retain the exact error record; missing cases keep absent/null evidence without invented errors.
explicit_limits: F1 final-evidence conjunction only. Cleanup branches, real process ownership, stopped-exec, runtime/provider closure, real adapter/helper acceptance, source-model/solver semantics and signals are not established by these fake scenarios.
